summary: from_yaml converts a YAML string into a structured variable using PyYAML's safe_load, for contexts without automatic conversion.
questions: How do I parse a YAML string into a variable?

answer_card.title: from_yaml filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ yaml_string | from_yaml }}` converts a YAML string to a structured variable, using PyYAML's `yaml.safe_load`. Use it where Ansible doesn't convert automatically.
